info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Term Deposit Creation API
info.description: The Term Deposit Creation API facilitates the establishment of term deposit accounts for customers within the banking system. This endpoint allows financial institutions to efficiently manage and configure term deposits tailored to individual customer needs. Typical consumers include bank representatives and automated onboarding systems that assist customers in securing their savings with attractive interest rates over defined terms. By engaging with this API, institutions can streamline the deposit initiation process, enhancing customer experience and retention.

post.summary: Create a new term deposit for a specified customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new term deposit account for an existing customer identified by their unique customer ID. Ensure that all required fields are completed correctly to successfully create the term deposit.
